scope: Package the actual engine, web UI and offline rules/resources with source archive/build recipes, CycloneDX SBOM, upstream notices, checksums and provenance; prove atomic publish/recovery, replay, quota, secret exclusion and provider ownership (Requirement N31).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C31-owned implementation, test, fixture, release-documentation and packaging-wiring paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only README/START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/ to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)

hardware.required_profile: 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB RAM / 20480 MiB free disk

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic release contracts; the secret canary is inert and no real credential, provider state or plaintext is present.

commands.summary: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.
28 web/contract tests passed, including exact notices freshness, deterministic SBOM, unknown-license rejection, source selection, secret scanning and missing-engine fail-closed behavior.
All Go packages passed; the domain test package completed in 18.253s.

Five complete-release integration tests passed: artifact contents, checksums and live engine/web probes; byte-identical replay; secret-material fail-closed with prior preservation; SIGKILL before publish plus concurrent-writer rejection and restart recovery; real ulimit quota failure and recovery.
Rebuilt the web UI and engine; the engine binary hash remained 80f8dbc0d0d3df9cc4746d2c7b5e6dfff1b8e7d6dca2b34ee61183d9bd4b210e, proving the build recipe is stable with VCS stamping disabled.

Packaged the verified build and atomically published the complete 70-file artifact at dist/release with 69 checksum entries, 45 RESOURCES entries, 78 SBOM components, engine go1.27.2/0.0.1 and a 516-file source archive.
All 69 listed artifact files verified; no missing, extra or mismatched file.
Regenerated THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md from the committed npm, provider and toolchain locks; the contract test enforces exact freshness.
Repository contract validation passed; checked 318 JSON files and invariants.

resources.rules: authorization rules compile into the Go engine; offline contracts and the authorization matrix are included

reproducibility.scope: same source, host and locked toolchain

results.acceptance: Package the actual engine, web UI and offline rules/resources, source archive/build recipes, SBOM, upstream notices, checksums and provenance. A web-only artifact cannot satisfy this complete-product task.

limitations: The verification worktree was dirty; RELEASE.json records dirty=true and source tree 38e6254afa202d8686b947eb91ba051eab882251a2512495219a158407b4cdd2. Rebuild from a clean commit before publication.
No commit, push, signature, public artifact upload or host deployment was performed.
systemd and nginx templates were checked structurally; the unit was not installed or enabled and no host was provisioned.
The full OpenBao/Keycloak reference workflow from an installed release artifact, clean-host installed workflow and C40 publication remain C39/C40 proof.
Cross-host byte-for-byte reproducibility is not claimed; replay identity is proven on the recorded host and locked toolchain.
Provider container images are external pinned dependencies; their blobs and license texts are not embedded in this artifact.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Publication writes the new complete tree only after all checksums and inventories pass. The prior complete release is retained as dist/release.previous. SIGKILL before publish, a concurrent second writer and a real ulimit file-size failure all left the prior SHA256SUMS.txt unchanged; the next run reclaimed stale lock/stage state and published a complete release.
